timeline.event: Rung at dawn in Dolores by Miguel Hidalgo to call the uprising for independence
Moved to Mexico City and placed over the Palacio Nacional balcony; rung each 15 September since

tiers.everyday: Miguel Hidalgo rang the Bell of Dolores in 1810 to start Mexico's fight for independence. It now hangs at the National Palace and rings every 15 September.
tiers.student: INAH: the bell called the people of Dolores at dawn on 16 September 1810; in 1896 it was moved to Mexico City and placed on the Palacio Nacional's central balcony, where it is rung each 15 September for the Grito.
